task_summary: Detect dangling paper titles in a PPTX file, reformat them (font, size, color, bold), resize boxes for single-line display, center at bottom of each slide, and create a reference slide with auto-numbered deduplicated titles.
decomposition_rationale: The environment lacks python-pptx (only lxml, defusedxml, six are installed), so all manipulation must use raw ZIP+lxml. The task naturally splits into: (1) low-level PPTX ZIP/XML read-write utilities, (2) dangling title detection and reformatting logic, and (3) reference slide creation with numbered bullets. Keeping these separate ensures clean boundaries between I/O, detection/formatting, and slide creation concerns.

skills.name: evo-pptx-xml-io
skills.description: Low-level utilities for reading/writing PPTX files as ZIP archives with lxml XML parsing, without python-pptx. Provides functions to open a PPTX, parse slide XML, enumerate shapes, read/write XML attributes, and repackage modified content into a valid PPTX.
skills.responsibility: ZIP archive management, XML parsing with proper OOXML namespaces (DrawingML 'a:', PresentationML 'p:'), slide enumeration, and safe repackaging of modified PPTX files.
dr_sections: 5. Working with `lxml` to Manipulate OOXML Directly

skills.name: evo-pptx-title-detect-format
skills.description: Detects dangling (non-placeholder) paper title text boxes in slide XML using heuristics, applies font reformatting (Arial, size 16, color #989596, non-bold) at the run level via raw XML manipulation, calculates/adjusts box width for single-line display, and repositions titles to bottom-center of each slide.
skills.responsibility: Dangling title identification via XML heuristics (non-placeholder check, text content analysis), run-level typography manipulation in raw OOXML, text width estimation for box resizing, and spatial repositioning (bottom-center) using EMU coordinates.
dr_sections: 1. Reading and Iterating Slides and Shapes in `python-pptx`
3. Text Box Sizing, Positioning, and Spatial Mathematics
Heuristics for Title Detection at the Raw XML Level

skills.name: evo-pptx-reference-slide
skills.description: Creates a new slide at the end of the presentation with 'Reference' as the title and all unique paper titles as auto-numbered bullet points in the body, using raw OOXML XML construction with lxml.
skills.responsibility: New slide XML creation, presentation.xml and relationship file updates, title placeholder population, body text with auto-numbered bullets via a:buAutoNum elements, and deduplication of paper titles.
dr_sections: 4. Creating Slides and the Numbered List Dilemma
5. Working with `lxml` to Manipulate OOXML Directly
